english.title: Fail to provide food, bedding, drink and space for animal in premises other than slaughterhouse
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[the business operator]_
(B)_[a person engaged in the lairaging of animals]_

in respect of premises, other than a slaughterhouse, used for the killing of animals, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), failed to ensure that

(C)_[an adequate supply of suitable bedding material was provided for all animals kept in the lairage overnight]_
(D)_[an animal which was kept in a lairage, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMAL..), had drinking water available to it from appropriate facilities at all times]_
(E)_[a sufficient quantity of wholesome food was provided for an animal on its arrival at the lairage and twice daily thereafter]_
(F)_[food was provided in a way which would permit the animals to feed without unnecessary disturbance]_
(G)_[an animal which was lairaged untethered, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMAL..), was able to lie down, stand up and turn round without difficulty]_
(H)_[an animal which was lairaged tethered, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMAL..), was able to lie down and stand up without difficulty]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 30(1)(d) and 33(1) of, and paragraph 22 of Schedule 2 to, the Welfare of Animals at the Time of Killing (England) Regulations 2015.

other.penalty:
Summary: Fine

Time limit for prosecutions
6 monthsNote
Note that for offences committed since 12 March 2015, section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012 removes the limits on certain fines given by the Magistrates' Courts. Offences that were previously punishable by fines of 'prescribed sums' and that were limited to 'not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale' or 'not exceeding the statutory maximum', are now punishable by a fine of any amount.
